sentences.en: Welcome back to my slow English podcast.
sentences.tc: 歡迎回到我的慢速英語播客。

sentences.en: Today I am at my aunt's house. I traveled to the United States to visit my family.
sentences.tc: 今天我在姨媽家。我去美國探望我的家人。

sentences.en: I really missed the big houses and green trees and the hot Cheetos. Flaming hot Cheetos are.
sentences.tc: 我真的很想念那些大房子、綠樹和熱奇多。火熱的奇多是。

sentences.en: My favorite type of Cheetos. I also bought a new hat at the thrift store. It was only $6. Super cheap.
sentences.tc: 我最喜歡的奇多類型。我還在舊貨店買了一頂新帽子。才 6 美元。超便宜。

sentences.en: I bought it at the thrift shop. So, it's all secondhand clothing. Secondhand means that it's already been used. though it's previously been worn, but it's still really good quality. The weather.
sentences.tc: 我在舊貨店買的。所以，都是二手衣服。二手的意思是已經被使用過。雖然已經穿過了，但是品質還是不錯的。天氣。

sentences.en: In Nebraska has been so warm, but today, as you can see from my red nose, it's a little bit cold.
sentences.tc: 內布拉斯加州一直很溫暖，但今天，從我的紅鼻子可以看出，有點冷。

sentences.en: I had to wear a sweatshirt. It's a nice breeze, but I prefer the warm sun.
sentences.tc: 我不得不穿一件運動衫。微風徐徐，但我更喜歡溫暖的陽光。

sentences.en: How has your summer been so far? I know some people get a long vacation during the summer. But some people don't?
sentences.tc: 到目前為止你的夏天過得怎麼樣？我知道有些人在暑假期間有很長的假期。但有些人不這麼認為？

sentences.en: I remember my mom and my dad always had a vacation. During the summer.
sentences.tc: 我記得我媽媽和爸爸總是放假。夏季期間。

sentences.en: When it was warm?
sentences.tc: 什麼時候暖的？

sentences.en: We could all go out to swim or play at the park, but some of my friends parents would always work all year round. Some all yearround jobs are like doctors, sales.
sentences.tc: 我們都可以出去游泳或去公園玩耍，但我的一些朋友的父母總是全年工作。有些全年無休的工作，例如醫生、銷售。

sentences.en: People, waiters, and waitresses. Lots of workers don't get summer off. only really teachers do and only because the students need a break as well.
sentences.tc: 人、服務生和女服務生。很多工人沒有暑假。只有真正的老師才會這麼做，而且只是因為學生也需要休息。

sentences.en: What I enjoyed the most about living in the United States, specifically Nebraska, were the seasons?
sentences.tc: 我在美國，特別是內布拉斯加州生活時最喜歡的是季節？

sentences.en: I loved having chilly autumn or fall, snowy winters, blossoming springs and warm summers, or should.
sentences.tc: 我喜歡寒冷的秋天或秋天，白雪皚皚的冬天，繁花似錦的春天和溫暖的夏天，或者應該。

sentences.en: I say hot summers in Mexico. There's basically only two seasons, rainy and dry. Just like in Thailand,.
sentences.tc: 我說的是墨西哥炎熱的夏天。基本上只有兩個季節，雨季和旱季。就像在泰國一樣。

sentences.en: I remember there was only rainy season and dry season. I really missed having four seasons because even though winter here is super intense, the sidewalks are frozen ice. The streets.
sentences.tc: 我記得只有雨季和旱季。我真的很懷念四個季節，因為儘管這裡的冬天非常寒冷，人行道上卻結冰了。街道。

sentences.en: Roads are slippery. It's so easy to slip and hurt yourself. The fall is chilly.
sentences.tc: 道路很滑。很容易滑倒並傷害自己。秋天是寒冷的。

sentences.en: Sometimes the sun never shines and I can get allergies during the spring. It's all worth it for the gorgeous summers here. The summers in Nebraska,.
sentences.tc: 有時陽光永遠不會照耀，我在春天可能會過敏。為了這裡美麗的夏天，一切都是值得的。內布拉斯加州的夏天。

sentences.en: They're something else.
sentences.tc: 他們是別的東西。

sentences.en: They're so lovely. The birds chirping, the green landscapes everywhere you look, the gorgeous trees blowing in the wind and kids playing everywhere. Summer here is like in the movies. Definitely.
sentences.tc: 他們是如此可愛。鳥兒在嘰嘰喳喳地叫著，到處都是綠色的風景，美麗的樹木在風中搖曳，孩子們到處玩耍。這裡的夏天就像電影裡一樣。確實。

sentences.en: I really enjoy visiting my aunts and uncles and seeing my grandma and grandpa and shopping for new clothes and really just relaxing and eating so much food.
sentences.tc: 我真的很喜歡拜訪我的阿姨和叔叔，看到我的奶奶和爺爺，買新衣服，真的很放鬆，吃很多食物。

sentences.en: One thing about the United States is the food.
sentences.tc: 美國的一件事就是食物。

sentences.en: I feel so unhealthy when I'm here.
sentences.tc: 當我在這裡的時候我覺得很不健康。

sentences.en: I eat so much junk food. Doritos, Flaming Hot Cheetos, cinnamon rolls, nachos, hot dogs, donuts, slushies. There's too much here to eat. And it's so easy to eat everything, especially since.
sentences.tc: 我吃了很多垃圾食物。多力多滋、火焰熱奇多、肉桂捲、玉米片、熱狗、甜甜圈、冰沙。這裡有太多東西可以吃。而且吃所有東西都很容易，尤其是從那時起。
